answer.ruling: Take 25 warriors and 8 wood. Place the Keep in any corner as the starting clearing. Put one warrior in every clearing except the diagonally opposite corner. Place one sawmill, one workshop and one recruiter among the Keep clearing and its adjacent clearings, in any arrangement respecting building slots.
Put the remaining five buildings of each type on their tracks from right to left, leaving the leftmost space empty.
